A man said to Ikrimah, is it a lion in the Abyssinian language? Ikrimah said: The name of a lion in the Abyssinian language is Anbasa. Yaqub bin Ibrahim told me, he said: Ibn Ulayyah told us, he said: Abu Raja’ told us, on the authority of Ikrimah, regarding his statement: Fleeed from a lion, he said: The archers. Abu Kurayb told us: Waki` told us, on the authority of Israel, on the authority of Abu Ishaq, on the authority of Sulayman ibn Abdullah al-Saluli, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, who said: They are the archers. Bishr told us, he said: Yazid told us, he said: Saeed told us, on the authority of Qatada: She fled from the qasoora, meaning the snipers. Ibn Abd al-A’la told us: Ibn Thawr told us, on the authority of Muammar, on the authority of Qatada, regarding his statement, fleeing from a lion, he said: the lion’s arrows. Others said: They are the sniper. Who said that? Muhammad bin Saad told me, he said: My father told me, my uncle told me, he said: My father told me, on the authority of his father, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, She fled from the lion, meaning: the hunting men. Ibn Bashar told us: Muhammad ibn Ja`far told us: Shu`bah told us, on the authority of Abu Bishr, on the authority of Sa`id ibn Jubayr, regarding this verse, Fleeing from a lion, he said: They are the hunters. Abu Kurayb told us: Waki` told us, on the authority of Shu`bah, on the authority of Abu Busr, on the authority of Sa`id ibn Jubayr, who said: They are the hunters. Others said: They are a group of men. Who said that? Ibn Al-Muthanna told us: Muhammad Ibn Ja`far told us: Shu`bah told us, and Abu Kurayb told us: Waki` told us, on the authority of Shu`bah, on the authority of Abu Hamza, who said: I asked Ibn Abbas about the word qasoora, and he said: I do not know of it in the language of any of the Arabs as a lion. It is the nerve of men. Ibn Al-Muthanna told us: Abd Al-Samad bin Abd Al-Warith told us: I do not know of any Arab language that says that the lion is the nerve of men. Ibn Al-Muthanna told us, he said: Abd Al-Samad Ibn Abd Al-Warith told us, he said: I heard my father narrating, he said: Dawud told us, he said: Abbas Ibn Abd Al-Rahman, a client of Banu Hashim, told me, he said: Ibn Abbas was asked about Al-Qasura, he said: It is a gathering of men, did you not hear what so-and-so said in the pre-Islamic era: Oh, daughter of Luay, her situation in the neighborhood is like a cruel one. Others said: They are men's voices. Who said that? Abu Kuraib told us: Ibn Uyaynah told us, on the authority of Amr, on the authority of Ata’, on the authority of Ibn Abbas: She fled from a lion. He said: The people raised their voices. Abu Kuraib said: Rather, it is the lion. Who said that? Abu Kurayb told us: Waki’ told us, on the authority of Hisham bin Sa’d, on the authority of Zaid bin Aslam, on the authority of Abu Hurayrah: She fled from a lion. He said: It is a lion. Yunus told me, he said: Ibn Wahb told us, he said: Hisham bin Saad told me, on the authority of Zaid bin Aslam, on the authority of Ibn Silan, that Abu Hurairah used to say regarding the statement of God, fleeing from a lion, he said: the lion. Muhammad bin Muammar told me: Hisham told us, on the authority of Zaid bin Aslam, regarding the statement of God, fleeing from a lion, he said: the lion. Yunus told me, he said: Ibn Wahb told us, he said: Dawud ibn Qays told me, on the authority of Zayd ibn Aslam, regarding the statement of God: Fleeed from a lion, he said: It is the lion. Muhammad bin Khalid bin Khidash told me, he said: Salim bin Qutaybah told me, he said: Hammad bin Salamah told us, on the authority of Ali bin Zaid, on the authority of Yusuf bin Mihran, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, that he was asked about his saying flee from a lion. He said: In Arabic it is: the lion, in Persian: Shar, in Nabataean: Ariya, and in Abyssinian: Qasoura. Ali told me, he said: Abu Saleh told us, he said: Muawiyah told us, on the authority of Ali, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, his statement: Fleeed from a lion means: the lion. Abu Al-Sa’ib told me: Hafs bin Ghayath told us, on the authority of Hisham bin Sa’d, on the authority of Zaid bin Aslam, on the authority of Abu Hurairah, who said: The lion. Yunus told me, he said: Ibn Wahb told us, he said: Ibn Zayd said, regarding his statement, She fled from a lion, he said: The lion is the lion.
74:52: And His statement: Rather, every man among them desires to be given spread-out pages. God Almighty says: What is wrong with these polytheists in their turning away from this Qur’an is that they do not know that it is from God, but rather every man among them desires to be given a book from the heavens that is sent down to him. And the people of interpretation said something similar to what we said about that. Who said that? Bishr told us, he said: Yazid told us, he said: Saeed told us, on the authority of Qatada, regarding his statement: Rather, every man of them wants to be given spread out pages, he said: Some people have said: O Muhammad, if you want us to follow you, then bring us a letter specifically to so-and-so and so-and-so, in which we are commanded to follow you. Qatada said: They want to be given immunity without having done any work. Muhammad bin Amr told me, he said: Abu Asim told us, he said: Isa told us, and Al-Harith told me, he said: Al-Hasan told us, he said: Warqa’ told us, both of them, on the authority of Ibn Abi Nujayh, on the authority of Mujahid, regarding his statement, Rather, every one of them desires to be given spread out pages, he said: To so-and-so from the Lord of the Worlds.
74:53: And His statement: No, but they do not fear the Hereafter. God Almighty says: He mentioned: The matter is not as they claim, that if they were given spread-out pages they would be truthful. Rather, they do not fear the Hereafter. He says: But they do not fear the punishment of God, and they do not believe in the resurrection, reward, and punishment. So that is what led them to turn away from the remembrance of God, and made it easy for them to abandon listening to His revelation and its sending down. And the people of interpretation said something similar to what we said about that. Who said that? Bishr told us, he said: Yazid told us, he said: Saeed told us, on the authority of Qatada, regarding his statement: No, but they do not fear the Hereafter. What corrupted them was that they did not believe in the Hereafter, nor did they fear it. That is what corrupted them.
74:54: He, the Most High, means by His saying: No, it is a reminder. The matter is not as these polytheists say about this Qur’an, that it is magic that affects, and that it is the words of humans, but rather it is a reminder from God to His creation, reminding them of it. And the people of interpretation said something similar to what we said about that. Who said that? Bishr told us, he said: Yazid told us, he said: Saeed told us, on the authority of Qatada, his statement: No! It is a reminder meaning the Qur’an.
74:55: And His statement: So whoever wills, let him remember it. God Almighty says: So whoever wills, among God’s servants whom God has mentioned with this Qur’an, let him remember it, so he will be admonished and use what is in it of God’s commands and prohibitions.
74:56: God Almighty says: And they do not remember except that God wills. God Almighty says: They do not remember this Qur’an, learn from it, and apply what is in it, except that God wills that they remember it, because no one has power over anything except that God wills it, has power over it, and gives him the ability to do it. And His statement: He is worthy of piety and forgiveness, God Almighty says: God is worthy of His servants being able to fear His punishment for their disobedience to Him, so they avoid His disobedience and hasten to obey Him. And He is worthy of forgiveness, He says: He is worthy of His forgiveness of their sins if they do that, and He does not punish them for them even if they repent from them. And the people of interpretation said something similar to what we said about that. Who said that? Bishr told us, he said: Yazid told us, he said: Saeed told us, on the authority of Qatada: He is worthy of piety and of forgiveness. Our Lord is worthy of being feared for His prohibitions, and He is worthy of forgiveness. He forgives sins. Ibn Abd al-A’la told us: Ibn Thawr told us, on the authority of Muammar, on the authority of Qatada, regarding His statement, He is worthy of piety and worthy of forgiveness, he said: He is worthy of being avoided for His prohibitions, and He is worthy of forgiveness: He is worthy of being forgiven for sins.
